title: EtherCAT Async SDO Download
text: Transmit data asynchronously to subordinate device represented by service data object, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Data Type} sets Data type of CANopen register; {Index}, {Access Mode} selects access mode for CoE variables Single, {Subindex}, {Dimension}, {Network Device Index} sets the etherCAT network identifier, {SubDevice Name} sets the name of device that contains CANopen register character and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Data
ports.summary: Data to write to subordinate device numeric

ports.name: Enable
ports.summary: Enables block to download data int32

ports.name: Error
ports.summary: Report an EtherCAT network error 0 | integer

params.name: Access Mode
params.values: Select access mode for CoE variables Single Subindex (default) | Complete Access

params.name: Data Type
params.values: Data type of CANopen register double (default) | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean

params.name: SubDevice Name
params.values: Name of device that contains CANopen register character vector
